title: Common-source NMOS amplifier
description: Design a single-transistor NMOS common-source voltage amplifier with a resistive drain load: an inverting stage with a self-stabilizing DC bias point (no external bias generator) that must hold at least 6 dB of small-signal voltage gain at 1 kHz across the full sky130-style tt/ss/ff process corner, 1.62-1.98 V supply, and -40..125 C temperature matrix.

target_specs.corners: sky130-style tt/ss/ff process x 1.62-1.98V supply x -40..125C

reference.notes: Generic (non-PDK) NMOS models stand in for sky130 devices -- same PDK-free-reference-artifact precedent as examples/kb/rc-relaxation-oscillator; see cs_amp.spice/models.lib headers and README.md's 'Known limitation' note.

source.citation: Common-source amplifier is a standard first analog IC design course topic; framed here in the style of AnalogCoder's (Lai et al., AAAI 2025, arXiv 2405.14918) easy-tier task set, not reproduced from that repo (unlicensed).
